note: Authelia (Go server + React/Vite portal). Built the way authelia-scripts does it: web build into internal/server/public_html, copy api/, go build. Minimal config (file users, SQLite, filesystem notifier) with cookie domain 127.0.0.1; unauthenticated visit shows the login portal. LEFTHOOK=0 stops web/'s lefthook postinstall writing git hooks into the enclosing ATTa repo.
setup: cd web && npx -y pnpm@12.6.0 install --frozen-lockfile && npx -y pnpm@12.6.0 build
